## Validation

- [ ] Tests pass locally or the reason they could not be run is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and reusable-workflow examples are up to date.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data are included.
- [ ] Every commit uses a Conventional Commit subject and represents one focused, atomic change.
- [ ] Workflow changes have been reviewed for permissions, input validation, and action pinning.
